#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool solve(int w, int m) {
    if (m == 0) return true;
    int d = m % w;
    if (d == 0 || d == 1) return solve(w, m / w);
    if (d == w - 1) return solve(w, (m + 1) / w);
    return false;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    bool ok = solve(w, m);
    cout << (ok ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
